core_values: Preservation of cultural identity and heritage
Patriotic civic duty and national unity

economic_policy.taxation: Lower taxes on domestic businesses; tariffs on foreign goods to protect national industry; tax incentives for companies that manufacture domestically; oppose international tax agreements that cede sovereignty.
spending_priorities: Veterans' affairs and national service programmes
economic_policy.trade: Economic nationalism; high tariffs on strategic imports; reshoring of supply chains; bilateral deals only; withdraw from multilateral trade organisations.
economic_policy.regulation: Deregulate domestic industry to boost competitiveness; strict regulation of foreign investment in critical sectors; oppose international regulatory harmonisation.

social_policy.healthcare: National healthcare for citizens; restrict access for non-citizens; domestic pharmaceutical production; oppose global health governance that overrides national policy.
social_policy.education: Promote national history, language, and civic values in curriculum; oppose multicultural education mandates; fund vocational and military-track programmes.
social_policy.housing: Citizens-first housing allocation; restrict foreign property ownership; incentivise homeownership as foundation of stable communities.
social_policy.civil_rights: Equality under national law; oppose international human rights bodies overriding domestic legislation; protect freedom of speech against foreign ideological influence.
social_policy.immigration: Dramatically reduce immigration; end birthright citizenship for children of non-citizens; immediate deportation of illegal entrants; cultural assimilation requirements for legal immigrants.

governance.decentralization: Strong central government on matters of sovereignty, defence, and borders; local governance on community affairs; oppose supranational authority.
governance.transparency: Ban foreign funding of domestic political organisations; disclose all foreign lobbying; restrict dual citizens from holding sensitive government positions.
governance.electoral_reform: Strict voter ID with proof of citizenship; oppose mail-in voting expansion; mandatory civics test for voter registration; ban foreign observation of elections.

environment.climate_action: National interests over international climate commitments; oppose binding international emissions targets; invest in domestic clean technology on national timeline.
environment.energy: Full energy independence; develop all domestic resources including fossil fuels and nuclear; strategic energy reserves; oppose energy dependence on foreign nations.
environment.conservation: Protect national landscapes as cultural heritage; national parks as symbols of identity; oppose foreign-funded environmental campaigns that restrict domestic resource use.

security.defense: Military supremacy as non-negotiable; expand armed forces; modernise defence industry domestically; mandatory national service consideration.
security.law_enforcement: Zero tolerance for organised crime and foreign criminal networks; expand border patrol; harsh penalties for treason and espionage; fund counter-terrorism.
security.foreign_policy: Sovereignty-first diplomacy; withdraw from international organisations that constrain national action; bilateral alliances based on mutual interest; oppose humanitarian interventionism.
